summary: This is a Makefile target named 'phplint' that runs PHP's built-in linter on index.php to check for syntax errors, then prints a confirmation message if no errors stop execution.

explanations.2: The hyphen prefix tells Make to ignore errors from this command — if the lint check fails, Make won't abort the entire target.
explanations.3: This echo only runs if the previous command succeeded, showing that the script is proceeding normally.
